clauses.text: If the text does not establish which applies, the result is INSUFFICIENT. Do not infer approval from the word refund.
NEW_REFUND_REQUEST means the customer asks the merchant to initiate a refund that has not already been approved.
REFUND_STATUS means the customer asks about the progress, timing, or arrival of a refund already approved or issued.
